categories.name: Jackets & coats
categories.description: Denim, sherpa and wool for every kind of weather.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.description: Scarves, decks and the finishing touches.

products.name: Washed Trucker Jacket
products.short_description: A light-wash denim trucker with a boxy fit and chest pockets.
products.description:
Cut from heavy rigid denim and washed for a lived-in light blue.

Wear it open over a tee or buttoned up when the wind picks up.

Styled in the look “Skate day”.

products.name: Black Slim Jeans
products.short_description: Slim through the leg with a little stretch and a cropped hem.
products.description:
Our everyday slim jean in a deep black that stays black wash after wash.

Roll the hem once to show off your socks.

Styled in the look “Skate day”.

products.name: Classic Skate Shoes
products.short_description: Low-top canvas skate shoes with a grippy waffle sole.
products.description:
Double-stitched canvas and a vulcanised sole made for boards and pavements.

Styled in the look “Skate day”.

products.name: Graphic Street Deck
products.short_description: A seven-ply maple deck with a hand-drawn graphic.
products.description:
Seven plies of maple pressed into a medium concave, finished with an original graphic.

Styled in the look “Skate day”.

products.name: Oversized Denim Jacket
products.short_description: A roomy mid-blue denim jacket with dropped shoulders.
products.description:
Cut big on purpose, so it layers over hoodies and knits.

Mid-blue wash with tonal stitching.

Styled in the look “Denim on denim”.

products.name: Ripped Skinny Jeans
products.short_description: High-rise black skinny jeans with ripped knees.
products.description:
A high rise, a close fit and knees that are already broken in.

Styled in the look “Denim on denim”.

products.name: Teal Canvas Hi-Tops
products.short_description: Canvas hi-top sneakers in teal with contrast laces.
products.description:
The classic hi-top in a bright teal canvas, with a cushioned insole.

Styled in the look “Denim on denim”.

products.name: Sherpa Denim Jacket
products.short_description: A dark denim jacket lined with warm faux sherpa.
products.description:
Dark indigo denim with a faux sherpa collar and lining for colder days.

Styled in the look “Off duty”.

products.name: Painted Black Jeans
products.short_description: Black straight jeans with hand-painted lettering.
products.description:
Each pair is painted by hand, so no two are exactly alike.

Styled in the look “Off duty”.

products.name: White Canvas Sneakers
products.short_description: Clean white canvas sneakers that go with everything.
products.description:
A simple white canvas sneaker with a natural rubber sole.

Styled in the look “Off duty”.

products.name: Blush Wool Coat
products.short_description: A long single-breasted coat in soft blush wool.
products.description:
Tailored through the shoulders and long enough to cover a skirt or a blazer.

Fully lined, with deep pockets.

Styled in the look “City coat”.

products.name: Paisley Silk Scarf
products.short_description: A large printed silk scarf in muted paisley.
products.description:
Printed silk twill, big enough to wrap twice.

Styled in the look “City coat”.

products.name: Suede Ankle Boots
products.short_description: Black suede ankle boots on a slim heel.
products.description:
Soft black suede on a stacked heel, with an inside zip.

Styled in the look “City coat”.

products.name: Stripe Ringer Tee
products.short_description: A fine-stripe ringer tee with contrast trims.
products.description:
Soft cotton jersey in red and black stripes, with ribbed contrast trims.

Styled in the look “Weekend stripe”.

products.name: Distressed Light Jeans
products.short_description: Straight light-wash jeans with ripped knees.
products.description:
A straight leg in a bleached light wash, ripped at the knees.

Styled in the look “Weekend stripe”.

products.name: Classic Low Sneakers
products.short_description: Black low-top sneakers with a white side stripe.
products.description:
Suede and canvas uppers on a padded collar, with the white side stripe.

Styled in the look “Weekend stripe”.
products.materials: Suede and canvas upper, rubber sole

products.name: Chevron Knit Sweater
products.short_description: A chunky knit with a camel and cream chevron.
products.description:
A relaxed chunky knit with a bold chevron in camel and cream.

Styled in the look “Autumn knit”.

products.name: White Denim Shorts
products.short_description: High-rise white denim shorts with a frayed hem.
products.description:
A high waist and a raw, frayed hem.

Styled in the look “Autumn knit”.

products.name: Over-the-Knee Suede Boots
products.short_description: Tan suede boots that reach over the knee.
products.description:
Stretch suede that stays up on its own, on a low block heel.

Styled in the look “Autumn knit”.
